title: Optimize trigram pattern cleaning fast path
constraints: Preserve trigram LIKE and ILIKE candidate search semantics
rationale: Trigram search cleans LIKE patterns by removing '%' and '_' into a new String for every lookup. Patterns without wildcards can reuse the original pattern slice, while wildcard patterns can clean into a preallocated String.
steps: Detect LIKE wildcard bytes before allocating a cleaned pattern
Borrow the original pattern when no wildcard is present
Preallocate cleaned pattern storage when wildcards are present
Verify trigram unit behavior and LIKE/ILIKE integration behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation churn in trigram-backed pattern lookup without changing candidate bitmaps.
